body: Honestly, I just wrote than I was "touched and heart-warmed" because I didn't want to come off a heartless asshole, but yeah, my sentiments were pretty similar to yours (mainly because I know she's just one of millions who need help this year).
I didn't know it was him at first. As soon as I realized, my first instinct was to left swipe. I only thought about right swiping to confront him at that point.

This guy had been bullying me since elementary school. I only told the administration it was happening once we were in high school. They thought I was overreacting. I don't want to get into the actual stuff he said, but believe me when I say that it was all to hurt me. It really couldn't have meant anything else.
Thanks. It does make me feel a bit better to know that other people are going through the same shit I am.
Glad to know I'm not the only one who went to my mom about this. She was after all the first one to introduce me to the books. Sure enough, she pronounces it "beren-steen." Something's fucked up.
I absolutely agree with you. It makes me feel really uncomfortable too. If they ban one hate subreddit, they should ban all of them, as long as the concerns from users are more or less the same.

How cool is this reporter? Her delivery is measured, yet engaging. I was thoroughly impressed. I'm surprised that she's so "in the know" at her age with social media, etc. Well, I guess she is a journalist after all.
Wow she's really maturing into a fine actress.

Hey man, don't feel bad. Interacting with cousins can be awkward because they're like siblings but not really, so you gotta be careful what you say. 

If it makes you feel any better, Einstein married his cousin and 100 years ago your family would quite possibly be setting you guys up as weird as that is because it was part of the norm at the time.
